Opens the light by roughly a stop (+1.05 EV) and relaxes the distance between light and dark (−15). Leans the balance warm, reds up and blues down (+8) and quiets the colour (−25). source.origin: Built with this app’s own engine

mapped: exposure → exposure (gain on scene-linear light, in stops)
saturation → saturation (mix toward and away from luma)
fade → fade (blacks lifted, whites pulled in together)

presets.name: Night Ledger — lifted blacks
presets.description: A cinematic frame built mainly on the fall-off at the edges and the split tone between shadows and highlights. Holds the light back by two thirds of a stop (−0.60 EV), drops the level of the whole print (−9) and tightens the distance between light and dark (+27). Leans the balance cool, blues up and reds down (−22) and quiets the colour (−28). Lifts the blacks and softens the whites (fade 25), splits the tone, warm highlights over cool shadows (+34) and closes hard on the corners (vignette 48).

source.origin: Built with this app’s own engine

mapped: exposure → exposure (gain on scene-linear light, in stops)
brightness → brightness (one additive level across the print)
saturation → saturation (mix toward and away from luma)
fade → fade (blacks lifted, whites pulled in together)
toning → toning (one split-tone axis about luma)

presets.name: Faded Postcard — lifted blacks
presets.description: An aged-print frame built mainly on air in the blacks and how much colour survives. Opens the light by about a third of a stop (+0.35 EV), lifts the level of the whole print (+7) and relaxes the distance between light and dark (−35). Leans the balance warm, reds up and blues down (+15) and quiets the colour (−46). Opens the blacks wide and pulls the whites back (fade 67), splits the tone, warm highlights over cool shadows (+24) and lets the corners fall away (vignette 17).
